implementation: existing models.hydraulics.liquid_head_loss owner; no second solver
notes: Registry declares only head outputs in metres plus velocity/Reynolds/Darcy factor; it does not infer density, absolute pressure, mass flow, or power.
The regression constructs two caller-declared joint head scenarios and routes the existing owner through the shared registry-backed ensemble API.
Ensemble summaries remain design-conditional descriptions, not operational failure probabilities or confidence intervals.
